component.name: Immich Folder Watch
component.summary: Watch folders and upload new media to Immich

description.p: Immich Folder Watch monitors local folders and automatically uploads new photos and videos to your Immich server. It runs as a per-user desktop app with X11 and XWayland support, talking to Immich over its public HTTP API rather than touching the server's storage directly.

ul.li: Automatically upload screenshots into a dedicated Immich album.
Watch a DSLR or SD-card import folder and send new photos through.
Ingest scanner output into a family archive.
Pick up files dropped by another tool into a staging folder.
Per-folder sync modes: upload only new files, upload everything in the folder, or keep the folder bidirectionally in sync with its Immich album (additive — local files are never deleted).
Optional per-folder album placement; missing albums are created automatically.
Waits until files are fully written before upload; retries transient failures.
Realtime status via Socket.IO and desktop notifications.
English and German UI with OS auto-detection and live language switching.
